_note: Labels were written by reading each sampled file in full, or for long files every line a broad search for algorithm names surfaced plus its surrounding code, before the scanner was run on the sample. A usage counts when executable code uses, configures, selects, imports or implements the algorithm; names in comments, docstrings and messages, and flags that turn an algorithm off, do not.
